title: Reports from the City Administrative Officer and the Bureau of Engineering relative to the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Second Homelessness Funding Report.
text:
[Council File 23-1022-S40]
Reports from the City Administrative Officer and the Bureau of Engineering relative to the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Second Homelessness Funding Report.
(This item is referred to the Homelessness and Health Committee and the Budget and Finance Committee)
Funding allocation, lease, and continued use for a period of up to five years for the Residential Interim Housing/Low Barrier Navigation Center at 600 East 116th Place for those experiencing homelessness, are statutorily exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act under PRC Section 21080.27.5, applicable to low barrier navigation centers; Public Resources Code Section 21080.10(c) as a contract approval providing homelessness services; and Government Code Section 8698.4(a)(4) governing homeless shelter projects under a shelter crisis declaration.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Financial Policies Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Funding allocation and lease for a Residential Interim Housing and Low Barrier Navigation Center at 600 East 116th Place for those experiencing homelessness.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, as amended, forthwith. Council adopted Motion (Jurado - Blumenfield) to adopt the Budget and Finance Committee and the Homelessness and Health Reports as amended by Amending Motion 34A (Jurado - Yaroslavsky) forthwith (Sep 16, 2026); Council adopted item, as amended, forthwith. Council adopted Motion (Jurado - Blumenfield) to adopt the Budget and Finance Committee and the Homelessness and Health Reports as amended by Amending Motion 34A (Jurado - Yaroslavsky) forthwith (Sep 16, 2026); Council action final
